provenance.title: Message templates (demo)
provenance.note: Written for this prototype; add Sinhala and Tamil versions in the app.

records.name: Flood warning
records.body: FLOOD WARNING {date} {time}: rising water in {areas}. {details} Move valuables up and be ready to leave. Help: {hotline}

records.name: Evacuate now
records.body: EVACUATE NOW: {areas}. {details} Go to the nearest safety centre or higher ground. Help: {hotline}

records.name: Landslide warning
records.body: LANDSLIDE WARNING: {areas}. {details} Watch for cracks, tilting trees and muddy springs. Leave slopes now. Help: {hotline}

records.name: Safety centre open
records.body: SAFETY CENTRE OPEN in {areas}: {details} Bring ID, medicines and drinking water. Help: {hotline}

records.name: Boil drinking water
records.body: WATER SAFETY {areas}: {details} Boil drinking water or use bottled water until further notice. Help: {hotline}

records.name: All clear
records.body: ALL CLEAR {areas} {date}: {details} Return only when officials confirm your road and home are safe. Help: {hotline}

records.name: Press briefing notice
records.subject: Press briefing: {incident}
records.notes: Invite the media to a briefing.

records.name: Situation update to media
records.subject: Situation update: {incident}, {date} {time}

records.name: Media release: situation
records.subject: Media release: {incident}

records.name: Media release: all clear
records.subject: All clear: {incident}

records.name: Official letter
records.subject: {subject}
records.notes: Letters to other organisations: situation, request, notice.

records.name: Request for assistance
records.subject: Request for assistance: {subject}
records.notes: Asking another organisation for supplies, people or equipment.
